claims: Each emitted review reason has a deterministic affected-item count.
Source revision drift counts as one revision event; model add, remove and change reasons count affected models.
Unchanged reports expose an empty reason-count map.
Reason-count output is deeply immutable and does not authorize or execute provider calls.
limitations: Static catalog drift counts do not prove provider availability, routing validity or output quality.
Real-provider M-01 closure remains separately gated.
